headline: Uzbekistan's Nine-Month Foreign Trade Turnover Rises 6.3% to $65.4B
summary: Uzbekistan's foreign trade turnover rose 6.3% to reach $65.4 billion over the first nine months of the year.
why: Foreign trade turnover measures international commercial exchange and export-import activity for developing national economies.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Higher trade volume figures indicate expansion in commercial import and export flows.
